episodes.title: One Big Mess
episodes.summary: Spider-Man teams up with Iron Man when Ultron plans to pollute the city.

episodes.title: Uh Oh, It's Magic!
episodes.summary: Spider-Man teams up with Thor when Loki plans to ruin everbody's summer fun.

episodes.title: That Drone Cat
episodes.summary: After an intense battle with Doc Ock, Spidey and his pal Miles Morales accidentally scare a cat named Mittens, sending her scampering into the city. As our heroes desperately try to catch the runaway feline, Miles teaches Spidey to learn from his mistakes.

episodes.title: Rock and Roll
episodes.summary: When Spidey and Ant-Man try to rescue people off a collapsing bridge, Hulk decides to pitch in but his "smashing" makes things worse. In order to save everyone, all three heroes discover the importance of self-control and thinking before you act.

episodes.title: Electric Youth
episodes.summary: When Spidey and Ms. Marvel both show up to stop a bank robbery, they have to put aside their differences and work together to take down the evil Electro!

episodes.title: The Toys Are Back in Town
episodes.summary: Spidey teams up with the famous Captain America to track down a toy thief known as the Tinkerer! As our heroes rescue the stolen toys, Captain America reminds Spider-Man that being a hero means doing the right thing, no matter what.

episodes.title: Way Outer Space
episodes.summary: Spider-Man teams up with Captain Marvel to save the astronauts on a malfunctioning shuttle.

episodes.title: Family Friendly
episodes.summary: When Absorbing Man destroys a bridge, separating kids from their parents, Spider-Man teams with Black Panther and is reminded that there's nothing more important than family.

episodes.title: Stomp and Listen
episodes.summary: Spidey joins forces with Wasp to stop the rampaging Rhino and soon learns that the best way to get what you want is to speak clearly and stand up for yourself.

episodes.title: I'm Positive!
episodes.summary: During a frustrating chase to stop Stegron from destroying a museum, Spider-Man gets a boost from his pal Reptil, who teaches him the power of positive thinking.

episodes.title: Evil Mittens
episodes.summary: Spider-Man, Ant-Man, and Wasp work together to get Mittens down from the tree. Unfortunately, Ant-Man uses a growing disk on Mittens causing him to go on a rampage.

episodes.title: Doctor Octopus's Garden
episodes.summary: Spider-Man teams up with Ghost-Spider when Doctor Octopus steals the Green Diamond and other green things in a museum.

episodes.title: Mine!
episodes.summary: Iron Man invents a tractor beam at the same time when Rhino has escaped from prison. When Spider-Man borrows it from Iron Man when the tractor beam isn't finished, Rhino gets magnetized enough to attract every item in the city.

episodes.title: Now That's Funny
episodes.summary: When Black Panther unveils a vehicle made from Vibranium, it is hijacked by Ultron. Spider-Man and Black Panther must team up to reclaim the vehicle and defeat Ultron.

episodes.title: LISTEN
episodes.summary: When Green Goblin robs a bank, Spider-Man accidentally loses Captain America's shield which he can't control as they work to reclaim the shield and defeat Green Goblin.

episodes.title: Sticky Mittens
episodes.summary: When a beekeeper's honey bees go missing, Spider-Man and Ms. Marvel discover that Swarm is responsible where he plans to have the honey for himself which also prevents the plants from being pollinated. Spider-Man and Ms. Marvel must rescue the honey bees and defeat Swarm and his Techno-Bees.

episodes.title: Cloudy With A Chance of Smiles
episodes.summary: When Spider-Man gets infected with the Venom symbiote, Hulk must get control of his emotions in order to save Spider-Man and New York from the Venom symbiote.

episodes.title: That's Why They Make Chocolate & Vanilla
episodes.summary: Spider-Man and Spider-Girl head to an ice cream parlor where their plans to obtain ice cream are thwarted when Electro plans to short-circuit the fuse boxes for the ice cream parlors since the ice cream always melts in his hands.

episodes.title: You Go High, I'll Go Low
episodes.summary: When Hobgoblin steals all the money from the bank, Spider-Man goes after him and runs into Falcon who is also after Hobgoblin after he stole Falcon's power ray. They now must work together to defeat Hobgoblin and reclaim the power ray.

episodes.title: It's An Alien!
episodes.summary: Spider-Man and Captain Marvel come across a crashed spaceship. They discover that its passenger Miek is stealing sugar while leaving green slime.

episodes.title: Sorry Seems To Be The Hardest Word
episodes.summary: As Spider-Man escorts Black Panther to the convention center, they spot Nebula who is carrying a box that contains a replacement part for her crashed ship as her running out into the road causes Black Panther to crash his power car. Spider-Man must persuade Black Panther and Nebula to make up for that incident.

episodes.title: The Claws of Life
episodes.summary: Spider-Man runs into Rocket Raccoon and Groot when they are tracking down Blackjack O'Hare. As they work together to stop Blackjack O'Hare from stealing gold, Spider-Man must teach Rocket Raccoon that yelling is not the best way to get things done.

episodes.title: Not So Dry Cleaners
episodes.summary: Spider-Man is recruited by Doctor Strange to help with his Sorcerer Spring Cleaning Time at the Sanctum Sanctorum. After most of it is done, the final thing to do is for Doctor Strange and Spider-Man to wash the Cloak of Levitation.

episodes.title: From Hulk to Eternity
episodes.summary: While at the beach, Spider-Man accidentally wrecks Hulk's sandcastle while playing volleyball with She-Hulk. When Hulk builds one that is too large enough to threaten the boardwalk, Spider-Man and She-Hulk must help Hulk keep the collapsing sandcastle from burying everything on the boardwalk.

episodes.title: Sticky Rain
episodes.summary: When the city's new park and playground is having a ribbon-cutting ceremony, it is crashed by a left-out Hobgoblin who starts dumping garbage all over it. Spider-Man and Miles Morales must work to stop Hobgoblin's littering spree.

episodes.title: Try It, You'll Like It
episodes.summary: When Spidey is feeling nervous about a mission to outer space, Iron Man reminds his apprehensive apprentice that trying new things is just as important as being confident in what you already know.

episodes.title: Bend, Don't Break
episodes.summary: Spidey and Ghost-Spider chase the rampaging Rhino, but when their original plan doesn't slow him down, Spidey is swiftly reminded that super heroes need to be flexible with their plans.

episodes.title: That's What Friends Are For
episodes.summary: When his webs won't work during a fight with Green Goblin, Spidey is reminded by his flexible super-friend, Ms. Marvel, that he has more than one super power: he also has super-smarts!

episodes.title: Happy Birthday
episodes.summary: Spidey and Captain America celebrate Cap's birthday but, of course, no Avenger's birthday can go uninterrupted! It seems like Loki's up to his usual mischief... or is he?

episodes.title: Things That Go HaHa! In The Night
episodes.summary: Spidey and Spider-Girl take on magical menace Morgan Le Fay, but when she conjures a mystical monster, our spider-heroes are forced to face their fears.

episodes.title: Charge Ahead
episodes.summary: Spidey swings into his arc-powered pal, Ironheart, as the entire city loses electricity! With Ironheart's suit shorting out too, these amazing friends will need to find a creative solution together.

episodes.title: Aww… Do I Have To
episodes.summary: When Hulk has his super-strength stolen by the maniacally magical Morgan Le Fay, he and Spidey are forced to think outside-the-box and remember that an open mind is a great tool for saving the day!

episodes.title: It's On Me
episodes.summary: Spidey and Captain America learn a thing or two about responsibility when Cap decides to leave his new Victory Bike unlocked, only for it to get hijacked by the belligerent cyborg-space-bunny Blackjack!

episodes.title: Promises Promises
episodes.summary: Mr. Fantastic and Spidey are building a brand-new Web-Jet when they're visited by Mittens the cat. Spidey promises Mr. Fantastic that he'll put Mittens outside but doesn't keep his promise, leading to catastrophic kitten chaos!

episodes.title: Outside the Box
episodes.summary: Diamonds are being stolen one-by-one from the jewelry store, so Spidey partners up with The Invisible Woman, aka Sue Storm, to solve the mystery! Who could it BEE?

episodes.title: It's Clobberin' Time
episodes.summary: During an aggravating attack by The Trapster, Spidey and The Thing accidentally get glued to each other! But before Thing clobbers himself for making a mistake, Spidey Reminds him to take a deep breath and remember that super heroes clobber crime, not themselves.

episodes.title: It's Too Darn Hot
episodes.summary: Spidey and the Human Torch team up to take down Sandman, who's snatching people's stuff at the beach! But when Torch spends too much time showing off, Sandman escapes and our heroes learn that too much of a good thing can be a bad thing.

episodes.title: One For All and All 4 One
episodes.summary: Faced with an especially challenging power-absorbing super villain, the Fantastic Four forgets how to work as a team. Good thing Spidey's there to remind them why there are the world's most fantastic family!

episodes.title: Building Bridges
episodes.summary: Captain Marvel and Spidey's relaxing day at the park is ruined by one of Rhino's rampages! But for Captain Marvel, every problem - no matter how big - has a super hero solution.

episodes.title: Obstacle, Of Course
episodes.summary: Spidey arrives in Wakanda for Black Panther's birthday party which, of course, turns out to be a very dangerous obstacle course set up by Black Panther's sister, Shuri. The royal siblings are always competitive but, this time, they may have gone a little too far!
